sources.title: White-tailed deer — Ontario Hunting Regulations Summary

conditions.text: A deer licence and the applicable seal or tag are required. North Ground cannot verify what you hold; confirm your own licensing before hunting.
Taking an antlerless deer generally requires an additional validated tag obtained through the antlerless deer draw. North Ground does not evaluate draw outcomes or tag validation.

conditions.text: Some units also run controlled deer hunts with their own seasons and hunt codes. North Ground has not certified those and they are not reflected in this result.

sources.title: Wild turkey — Ontario Hunting Regulations Summary

conditions.text: A wild turkey licence and a valid turkey tag are required, and the season is one bird per tag. North Ground cannot verify what you hold.
The spring season is restricted to bearded turkeys. Identifying the bird before shooting is the hunter's responsibility and North Ground cannot do it for you.
Wild turkey harvests must be reported to the province. North Ground does not file reports.

sources.title: Black bear — Ontario Hunting Regulations Summary

conditions.text: A black bear licence and a valid bear tag are required for the wildlife management unit you hunt in. North Ground cannot verify what you hold.
It is illegal to hunt a bear cub, or a female bear with a cub. Identification is the hunter's responsibility and North Ground cannot make it for you.
Non-residents generally must hunt black bear through a licensed outfitter or on land they own. North Ground has not certified which arrangement applies to you.

Every moose season requires a validated moose tag allocated through the province's tag draw, and the tag determines both the season and the animal you may take. North Ground does not evaluate draw applications, points or tag validation.
A calf tag, a bull tag and a cow/calf tag permit different animals. Which one you hold decides what is legal to take, and North Ground cannot verify it.

Some units also run resident seasons with controlled hunter numbers, including seasons for hunters with a lower limb disability and unit-specific rules. North Ground has not certified those and they are not reflected in this result.
